details: Version 4.0.0 carries the covert auto-follow described for 2.0.0 and 3.0.0. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, 120 seconds after the socket is created, it fetches https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dgxeonking/strings/refs/heads/main/strings.json and sends the WhatsApp FOLLOW query for every channel ID in it, one every 11 seconds, using the installer's logged-in session, with all errors swallowed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
